info.title: Kommunicate Universal API
info.description: Manage support conversations, users, messages, and agent routing

put.description: Updates a conversation assignee in Kommunicate.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

assignee.description: Human agent email or ID to assign to the conversation.

sendNotifyMessage.description: Whether Kommunicate should send a notification message; defaults to true.

takeOverFromBot.description: Remove bots from the conversation when true.

ofUserId.description: Admin or agent user ID to route into the required Of-User-Id header.
